name: Bases Property Repair
changes: The Pro notice for the change journal now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Rename the property in your notes first, then run 'Repair property references in base files' to update your bases.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Property Repair is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
